1: Count it joy when you are tested, because testing produces endurance. Ask God for wisdom without doubting. God tempts no one; every good gift comes from him. Be doers of the word and not hearers only.
Real religion is caring for orphans and widows and keeping oneself unstained by the world.
2: Do not give the rich man the best seat and tell the poor man to stand. Whoever breaks one point of the law is guilty of all of it. What good is faith that does nothing for a brother who is cold and hungry? Abraham's faith was completed by his works.
Faith and works belong together. A faith that never acts is not saving faith.
3: Teachers will be judged more strictly. The tongue is small like a ship's rudder or a spark, yet it can set a forest on fire. With it we bless God and curse people made in his likeness. Wisdom from above is pure, peaceable and gentle.
Our words reveal our hearts. Controlling speech is a real test of maturity.
4: Fights come from desires at war inside us. Friendship with the world is enmity with God. Draw near to God and he will draw near to you. Do not boast about tomorrow; say, "If the Lord wills."
"God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble." Our plans are always in his hands.
5: Patience and the anointing of the sick

James warns the rich who cheat their workers. Be patient until the Lord comes, like a farmer waiting for rain. If anyone is sick, call the elders of the Church to pray over him and anoint him with oil. Confess your sins to one another.
This is the scriptural basis for the sacrament of the Anointing of the Sick. The prayer of a righteous person has great power.
